note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: Do these control valves lack position feedback?

evidence.text: valve FCV-A reads "FCV-A Fictional control-valve subject A" at U-A
no position transmitter or indicator (ZT, ZI) drawn on these valves

where: DCS/PLC configuration: valve positioner configuration (smart positioner? HART/fieldbus diagnostics?)
historian or DCS trend for FCV-A (no historian tag is mapped in this model for these)
a walkdown: a small step test on each loop in manual
data_requests.how: Compare controller output with measured response.

questions.decision_rule: Add feedback or diagnostics first on valves in energy- or safety-significant loops that show stiction or hunting.

typical_benefit.wording: "Control valve backlash and stiction... are major contributors to process variability." No % stated.
source_titles: S13: Improving Pumping System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, 2nd ed. (DOE + Hydraulic Institute; DOE/GO-102006-2079)

questions.limits: P&IDs often omit positioners; the model saying 'none drawn' does not mean none fitted.
